name: [RELEASE] Kuroku's Basket: Showdown
desc:
🏀Step into the world of Basketball Showdown, where teamwork, strategy, and skill collide on the court! In this thrilling multiplayer experience, compete in fast paced 5v5 basketball matches against friends and foes from around the globe.

🔥Select your style to unleash your inner miracle and dominate the court! Enter the zone and awaken your true powers, becoming an unstoppable force with increased abilities and insane powers!

CONTROLS:
[Shoot] – Left HOLD Click
[Pump fake] – Left Click
Pass – Right Click/F
Dribble – Q
Layup/Dunk/Block – Spacebar

The court awaits. Will you rise as the ultimate baller and lead your team to glory? Join the game and become a part of Basketball Showdown's generation of miracles!
